verses.ar: فَأجَابَ أَلِيفَازُ ٱلتَّيمَانِيُّ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.web: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «إِنِ ٱمْتَحَنَ أَحَدٌ كَلِمَةً مَعَكَ، فَهَلْ تَسْتَاءُ؟ وَلَكِنْ مَنْ يَسْتَطِيعُ ٱلِٱمْتِنَاعَ عَنِ ٱلْكَلَامِ؟
verses.kjv: [If] we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.web: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.he: הֲנִסָּ֬ה דָבָ֣ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ תִּלְאֶ֑ה וַעְצֹ֥ר בְּ֝מִלִּ֗ין מִ֣י יוּכָֽל׃

verses.ar: هَا أَنْتَ قَدْ أَرْشَدْتَ كَثِيرِينَ، وَشَدَّدْتَ أَيَادِيَ مُرْتَخِيَةً.
verses.kjv: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.web: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
verses.he: הִ֭נֵּה יִסַּ֣רְתָּ רַבִּ֑ים וְיָדַ֖יִם רָפֹ֣ות תְּחַזֵּֽק׃

verses.ar: قَدْ أَقَامَ كَلَامُكَ ٱلْعَاثِرَ، وَثَبَّتَّ ٱلرُّكَبَ ٱلْمُرْتَعِشَةَ!
verses.kjv: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.web: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.
verses.he: כֹּ֖ושֵׁל יְקִימ֣וּן מִלֶּ֑יךָ וּבִרְכַּ֖יִם כֹּרְעֹ֣ות תְּאַמֵּֽץ׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْآنَ إِذْ جَاءَ عَلَيْكَ ضَجِرْتَ، إِذْ مَسَّكَ ٱرْتَعْتَ.
verses.kjv: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
verses.web: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
verses.he: כִּ֤י עַתָּ֨ה ׀ תָּבֹ֣וא אֵלֶ֣יךָ וַתֵּ֑לֶא תִּגַּ֥ע עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ וַתִּבָּהֵֽל׃

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَتْ تَقْوَاكَ هِيَ مُعْتَمَدَكَ، وَرَجَاؤُكَ كَمَالَ طُرُقِكَ؟
verses.kjv: [Is] not [this] thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
verses.web: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
verses.he: הֲלֹ֣א יִ֭רְאָתְךָ כִּסְלָתֶ֑ךָ תִּ֝קְוָתְךָ֗ וְתֹ֣ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: اُذْكُرْ: مَنْ هَلَكَ وَهُوَ بَرِيءٌ، وَأَيْنَ أُبِيدَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمُونَ؟
verses.kjv: Remember, I pray thee, who [ever] perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
verses.web: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
verses.he: זְכָר־נָ֗א מִ֤י ה֣וּא נָקִ֣י אָבָ֑ד וְ֝אֵיפֹ֗ה יְשָׁרִ֥ים נִכְחָֽדוּ׃

verses.ar: كَمَا قَدْ رَأَيْتَ: أَنَّ ٱلْحَارِثِينَ إِثْمًا، وَٱلزَّارِعِينَ شَقَاوَةً يَحْصُدُونَهَا.
verses.kjv: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
verses.web: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.
verses.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתִי חֹ֣רְשֵׁי אָ֑וֶן וְזֹרְעֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל יִקְצְרֻֽהוּ׃

verses.ar: بِنَسَمَةِ ٱللهِ يَبِيدُونَ، وَبِرِيحِ أَنْفِهِ يَفْنَوْنَ.
verses.kjv: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
verses.web: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
verses.he: מִנִּשְׁמַ֣ת אֱלֹ֣והַ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וּמֵר֖וּחַ אַפֹּ֣ו יִכְלֽוּ׃

verses.ar: زَمْجَرَةُ ٱلْأَسَدِ وَصَوْتُ ٱلزَّئِيرِ وَأَنْيَابُ ٱلْأَشْبَالِ تَكَسَّرَتْ.
verses.kjv: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.web: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.he: שַׁאֲגַ֣ת אַ֭רְיֵה וְקֹ֣ול שָׁ֑חַל וְשִׁנֵּ֖י כְפִירִ֣ים נִתָּֽעוּ׃

verses.ar: اَللَّيْثُ هَالِكٌ لِعَدَمِ ٱلْفَرِيسَةِ، وَأَشْبَالُ ٱللَّبْوَةِ تَبَدَّدَتْ.
verses.kjv: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.
verses.web: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
verses.he: לַ֭יִשׁ אֹבֵ֣ד מִבְּלִי־טָ֑רֶף וּבְנֵ֥י לָ֝בִ֗יא יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃

verses.ar: «ثُمَّ إِلَيَّ تَسَلَّلَتْ كَلِمَةٌ، فَقَبِلَتْ أُذُنِي مِنْهَا رِكْزًا.
verses.kjv: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
verses.web: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
verses.he: וְ֭אֵלַי דָּבָ֣ר יְגֻנָּ֑ב וַתִּקַּ֥ח אָ֝זְנִ֗י שֵׁ֣מֶץ מֽ͏ֶנְהֽוּ׃

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْهَوَاجِسِ مِنْ رُؤَى ٱللَّيْلِ، عِنْدَ وُقُوعِ سُبَاتٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ،
verses.kjv: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.web: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
verses.he: בִּ֭שְׂעִפִּים מֵחֶזְיֹנֹ֣ות לָ֑יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֥ל תַּ֝רְדֵּמָ֗ה עַל־אֲנָשִֽׁים׃

verses.ar: أَصَابَنِي رُعْبٌ وَرِعْدَةٌ، فَرَجَفَتْ كُلَّ عِظَامِي.
verses.kjv: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
verses.web: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
verses.he: פַּ֣חַד קְ֭רָאַנִי וּרְעָדָ֑ה וְרֹ֖ב עַצְמֹותַ֣י הִפְחִֽיד׃

verses.ar: فَمَرَّتْ رُوحٌ عَلَى وَجْهِي، ٱقْشَعَرَّ شَعْرُ جَسَدِي.
verses.kjv: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
verses.web: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
verses.he: וְ֭רוּחַ עַל־פָּנַ֣י יַחֲלֹ֑ף תְּ֝סַמֵּ֗ר שַֽׂעֲרַ֥ת בְּשָׂרִֽי׃

verses.ar: وَقَفَتْ وَلَكِنِّي لَمْ أَعْرِفْ مَنْظَرَهَا، شِبْهٌ قُدَّامَ عَيْنَيَّ. سَمِعْتُ صَوْتًا مُنْخَفِضًا:
verses.kjv: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image [was] before mine eyes, [there was] silence, and I heard a voice, [saying],
verses.web: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
verses.he: יַעֲמֹ֤ד ׀ וְֽלֹא־אַכִּ֬יר מַרְאֵ֗הוּ תְּ֭מוּנָה לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י דְּמָמָ֖ה וָקֹ֣ול אֶשְׁמָֽע׃

verses.ar: أَٱلْإِنْسَانُ أَبَرُّ مِنَ ٱللهِ؟ أَمِ ٱلرَّجُلُ أَطْهَرُ مِنْ خَالِقِهِ؟
verses.kjv: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
verses.web: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
verses.he: הַֽ֭אֱנֹושׁ מֵאֱלֹ֣והַ יִצְדָּ֑ק אִ֥ם מֵ֝עֹשֵׂ֗הוּ יִטְהַר־גָּֽבֶר׃

verses.ar: هُوَذَا عَبِيدُهُ لَا يَأْتَمِنُهُمْ، وَإِلَى مَلَائِكَتِهِ يَنْسِبُ حَمَاقَةً،
verses.kjv: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
verses.web: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
verses.he: הֵ֣ן בַּ֭עֲבָדָיו לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וּ֝בְמַלְאָכָ֗יו יָשִׂ֥ים תָּהֳלָֽה׃

verses.ar: فَكَمْ بِٱلْحَرِيِّ سُكَّانُ بُيُوتٍ مِنْ طِينٍ، ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَاسُهُمْ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِ، وَيُسْحَقُونَ مِثْلَ ٱلْعُثِّ؟
verses.kjv: How much less [in] them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation [is] in the dust, [which] are crushed before the moth?
verses.web: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
verses.he: אַ֤ף ׀ שֹׁכְנֵ֬י בָֽתֵּי־חֹ֗מֶר אֲשֶׁר־בֶּעָפָ֥ר יְסֹודָ֑ם יְ֝דַכְּא֗וּם לִפְנֵי־עָֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: بَيْنَ ٱلصَّبَاحِ وَٱلْمَسَاءِ يُحَطَّمُونَ. بِدُونِ مُنْتَبِهٍ إِلَيْهِمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ يَبِيدُونَ.
verses.kjv: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding [it].
verses.web: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
verses.he: מִבֹּ֣קֶר לָעֶ֣רֶב יֻכַּ֑תּוּ מִבְּלִ֥י מֵ֝שִׂ֗ים לָנֶ֥צַח יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃

verses.ar: أَمَا ٱنْتُزِعَتْ مِنْهُمْ طُنُبُهُمْ؟ يَمُوتُونَ بِلَا حِكْمَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Doth not their excellency [which is] in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
verses.web: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
verses.he: הֲלֹא־נִסַּ֣ע יִתְרָ֣ם בָּ֑ם יָ֝מ֗וּתוּ וְלֹ֣א בְחָכְמָֽה׃
